column1: # ValidationError / BinaryError variants NO must-refuse corpus row exhibits.
# EXACT and DECREASE-ONLY: `refuse_corpus.rs` derives the variant lists from
# the enum sources, asserts this file is exactly (all variants) minus (variants
# a manifest row exhibits), and, against the merge-base with origin/main, that
# the set only SHRANK. So a NEW variant cannot land without a corpus row: it is
# absent here (the exactness check fails) and cannot be added (the shrink
# check fails). Delete a line when its variant gains a row.
#   structural   refused by plain `validate_module` on every lane; a consumer
#                that validates never meets it (gate 9 evidence; the
#                enforcement-links V census counts the ones no test names)
#   lane:<name>  refused only at a lane the corpus does not drive yet (the
#                linked import walk, the bundle lane, a dialect-schema
#                registry, the bound-certificate knob, a substituted handle
#                registry); a row needs a sidecar the manifest has no column for
#   unencodable  the writer refuses to produce bytes: no wire artifact exists
#   unreachable  measured dead: no input can produce it, the code refuses
